title: SEC↔PO-001: Security Posture for Release Planning + Compliance Milestone Tracking
description: The Security Engineer provides security risk assessments, required pre-release mitigations, compliance constraints affecting scope/timeline, compliance-milestone status, and the release security sign-off (which can block a release); the Product Owner/TPM provides visibility into features touching connectivity, data handling, or OTA (Over-the-Air) delivery that may carry security implications, plus schedule context for security work. Grounded in SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.9 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.11. The release security sign-off is a permanent HITL gate (HG-01): a BLOCKED sign-off is not overridable by the PO/TPM without the Security Engineer's explicit clearance.

security_release_posture.description: SEC→PO: risk assessment, mitigations, compliance milestones, and the release security sign-off.

release_security_signoff.description: Per-release security sign-off; can block the release (HG-01).

release_planning_visibility.description: PO→SEC: features touching security-relevant surfaces + schedule context.

surface.description: Surface that triggers mandatory SEC consultation.

x-macp.tier_rationale: The release security sign-off is the Security Engineer Release Veto (HG-01) — a permanent HITL gate. A BLOCKED sign-off halts the release and is not overridable by the PO/TPM (or CTO) without the Security Engineer's explicit clearance. ESC-SEC applies: agents may only propose; SEC owns all binding decisions here. Zero autonomous resolution.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (mandatory consultation for any feature involving new connectivity, data flows, or OTA mechanisms; per-release security sign-off)
confirm_conditions: release_security_signoff = APPROVED, or CONDITIONAL with the required pre-release mitigations enumerated and logged
every feature touching connectivity, data handling, or OTA was routed to SEC for the mandatory consultation
open critical/high findings are disclosed honestly
compliance milestones carry a status (and a target date where committed)
reject_conditions: a BLOCKED security sign-off presented as release-ready (gates the release — ESC-SEC / ESC-TIER1)
the PO/TPM overriding a SEC BLOCKED sign-off without the Security Engineer's explicit clearance (HG-01 — forbidden)
a feature touching connectivity, data handling, or OTA scheduled for release without the mandatory SEC sign-off
a change weakening the security baseline cleared without SEC sign-off and an ADR (Never Silently Deviate; ESC-SEC)
counter_conditions: a CONDITIONAL sign-off — request the remediation conditions be logged to the §3.3 checklist before proceeding (do not self-clear)
a compliance milestone lacks a committed target date — request the date before building the release plan around it
